summary: Channels adaptive source-manager density. Hide the provider filter and Source column when the real result set has only one provider, summarize that provider next to the result count, hide the Status column when the current result set has no meaningful background/private state, and restore all columns automatically when real variance exists. Preserve the accepted Source Manager structure and mobile collapse. Shared Shell, Navigation, data model, schema, migrations and updater mechanism remain unchanged. Production remains Owner manual.
